jobs_results.description:
This is where your work makes a difference.



At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.



Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.



Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 







Your Role at Baxter

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Sr Data Architect to join our team at Baxter Healthcare. As a Data Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the data architecture of data pipelines and modeling data into databases that expose data to the enterprise. This position requires a strong background in Data Architecture, SQL, Data Modeling, ETL/ELT, Data Warehousing, and Database technologies.  Are you ready to be the next Sr. Architect leader on our Baxter team?


What you'll be doing:

Designing and implementing the data architecture of data pipelines.Creating and maintaining Data Models that represent and optimize the data for databases.Advising Data Engineers on best practices for creating data pipelines.Developing and maintaining Data pipelines to provide secure and efficient data access to stakeholders.Collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and integrate data analytics into business operations.Ensuring data privacy and security by implementing appropriate controls and protocols.Staying up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in data architecture.
What you'll bring:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.  Master's degree preferred5 years of experience in data modeling or data warehousing.5 years of experience in AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud computing platformStrong background in SQL, ETL/ELT tools, Data Modeling tools, and RDBMS. Preferred experience with Unix, Linux or equivalentExperience with data engineering or data pipeline development is highly desirable.Strong understanding of data architecture principles and patterns.Excellent communication, collaboration and critical thinking skills.Experience with machine learning and predictive modeling.
Baxter is committed to supporting the needs for flexibility in the workplace. We do so through our flexible workplace policy which includes a required minimum number of days a week onsite. This policy provides the benefits of connecting and collaborating in-person in support of our Mission. The flexible workplace policy is subject to local laws and legal requirements. At its discretion, Baxter may decide to adjust, suspend, or discontinue as business needs change.


We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $152,000.00 to $198,000.00 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location.


Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: The Data Architect is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing the data architecture, models, standards, and patterns that enable scalable, trusted, and reusable enterprise data solutions at Gallagher
You will lead the architecture and design of complex data initiatives spanning operational, analytical, master, and reference data

This includes defining end-to-end data flows, developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing integration and modeling patterns, evaluating solution designs, and ensuring data platforms are designed for scalability, reliability, governance, security, and long-term maintainability
This is an individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities and no direct people management

You will work closely with data engineers, solution and enterprise architects, product teams, analytics, data science, governance, business stakeholders, and technology teams to translate business capabilities and data requirements into practical enterprise data architectures
Data Architecture & ModelingDesign end-to-end data architectures spanning source systems, ingestion, transformation, integration, master data, data lakes, warehouses, and downstream consumption
Develop and maintain conceptual and logical data models that accurately represent business domains, entities, relationships, and data requirements
Define reusable data architecture and modeling patterns that promote consistency across domains and technology platforms
Establish clear source-to-target architectures and data flows, including system-of-record, mastering, distribution, and consumption patterns
Guide the design of analytical, operational, master, and reference data solutions based on business and technical requirements
Define architecture for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured enterprise data
Ensure designs support scalability, interoperability, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability
Establish and promote standards for data architecture, modeling, integration, metadata, lineage, naming, documentation, and design
Conduct architecture and design reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and target-state architecture
Provide architectural direction to data engineering teams throughout design and implementation
Identify architectural risks, dependencies, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify or modernize existing solutions
Influence technical decisions across teams without direct management responsibility
Mentor engineers and other technical professionals on data architecture and modeling practices
Data Platform & Integration ArchitectureDefine architecture patterns across modern cloud data platforms, including Snowflake, Azure, Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, and SQL-based platforms
Design scalable data lake, data warehouse, data integration, and data product architectures
Define patterns for batch, near-real-time, API, event-driven, and file-based data integration where appropriate
Partner with engineering teams to ensure architecture can be implemented efficiently and operated reliably in production
Define patterns that reduce point-to-point integrations, duplicate data processing, unnecessary data movement, and tightly coupled solutions
Evaluate existing platforms and solutions and develop target-state and transition architectures to support modernization
Ensure architecture considers performance, resilience, recoverability, observability, and cloud cost
Partner with data governance and business teams to establish consistent definitions and models for critical enterprise data
Support master and reference data management strategies, including definition of authoritative sources, mastering, reconciliation, and distribution patterns
Ensure architecture clearly documents data movement, transformation, ownership, and consumption
Promote discoverable, governed, and reusable enterprise data products

Business, Engineering & AI PartnershipPartner with business, product, analytics, data science, security, engineering, governance, and technology teams to develop data solutions aligned to business priorities
Facilitate architecture discussions and drive decisions across teams with different technical and business perspectives
Communicate architecture decisions, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Build data foundations that support analytics, AI, machine learning, and other advanced data use cases
Ensure AI and analytics solutions are supported by well-designed, governed, and trusted data foundations
Balance strategic architecture direction with practical delivery needs, helping teams move toward the target state incrementally

SteerBridge is a modern technology company delivering innovative, mission‑focused solutions to the U.S. Government and private sector. Leveraging deep expertise in federal acquisition, digital transformation, and emerging technologies, we deliver agile, commercial‑grade capabilities that accelerate operational effectiveness and drive measurable mission success.

At the core of SteerBridge is our people—especially the veterans whose leadership, problem‑solving mindset, and commitment to excellence elevate every project we support. We don’t simply hire exceptional talent; we cultivate it, creating meaningful career pathways for veterans, military spouses, and professionals who share our passion for advancing technology and strengthening the missions we serve.




Position Overview

SteerBridge is seeking a Data Architect (Mid-Level) to support operations and sustainment efforts for the Modern Disability Claims program. This role will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data architectures that support claims intake, adjudication workflows, clinical and claims data integration, and performance analytics for the program.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience designing modern data solutions, developing data pipelines, and supporting enterprise analytics environments within cloud-based ecosystems.




Key Responsibilities

Design and implement scalable data architectures and data models that support analytics, reporting, and operational needs.Develop, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from multiple structured and unstructured sources.Build and maintain cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, and related infrastructure.Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders to develop data solutions supporting machine learning and advanced analytics initiatives.Implement and maintain data governance, security, data quality, and integrity standards across data environments.Monitor and optimize database and data platform performance, scalability, reliability, and availability.Support data modernization initiatives, including migration and transformation of legacy data environments to modern cloud-based architectures.


Required Qualifications

Eligibility requirements: U.S. citizenship is required for this position under applicable federal contract requirements. Candidate must also be able to obtain and maintain the security clearance required for the role, including a Public Trust clearance; an active Secret or Top Secret clearance also satisfies this requirement.Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.3+ years of experience in data architecture, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise data warehouse design.Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, Pandas, PySpark, NumPy, and Git.Experience with data warehousing technologies such as Databricks, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, or Apache Hive.Experience developing and automating large-scale data environments.


Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.Experience designing conceptual, logical, and physical data models and modern data lake and data warehouse architectures across AWS, Azure, or GCP.Experience with big data and distributed computing technologies such as Apache Kafka, Airflow, Spark, or NiFi.Experience supporting AI/ML workflows, analytics platforms, and large-scale data processing environments.Knowledge of data governance, security, compliance, CI/CD pipelines, and software development best practices.Experience supporting defense, healthcare, benefits administration, or other mission-critical federal programs.
